description: This Java class 'CategoryDescription' models the description details for a product category within an e-commerce system, including SEO metadata and category highlighting, and is mapped to a database table using JPA annotations.

classes.name: CategoryDescription
classes.description: A JPA entity class representing localized description data for product categories, including SEO metadata, highlighting, and associated category link.

methods.name: CategoryDescription(String name, Language language)
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the description with a name and language.

methods.name: getSeUrl
methods.description: Returns the SEO-friendly URL for the category.

methods.name: setSeUrl
methods.description: Sets the SEO-friendly URL for the category.

methods.name: getMetatagTitle
methods.description: Returns the meta title for SEO.

methods.name: setMetatagTitle
methods.description: Sets the meta title for SEO.

methods.name: getMetatagKeywords
methods.description: Returns the meta keywords for SEO.

methods.name: setMetatagKeywords
methods.description: Sets the meta keywords for SEO.

methods.name: getMetatagDescription
methods.description: Returns the meta description for SEO.

methods.name: setMetatagDescription
methods.description: Sets the meta description for SEO.

methods.name: setCategory
methods.description: Associates a Category object with this description.
